candidates.change_summary: Change supportsInterface to return false for IERC165 interface id (negate check), causing different return for supportsInterface(type(IERC165).interfaceId).
Make supportsInterface always return false (removes check against IAccessControl and super), so calls return different values for many ids including IAccessControl.
Make supportsInterface always return true (unconditionally), changing results for any queried interface id.
Change hasRole to return the negation of the stored membership (invert the boolean result).
Have hasRole always return false regardless of stored membership.
Have hasRole always return true regardless of stored membership.
Make hasRole ignore the provided account and always check membership of msg.sender instead.
Make hasRole ignore the provided role and always check membership of DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE for the given account.
